name: Motorcycle Simulator Toronto
summary:
The ride of your life, from the seat - through Toronto.

YOUR GARAGE
Start astride your bike in a luxury three-car garage at Humber Bay Shores. Touch the throttle and the door lifts onto your drive.

THE BIKE
A litre-class sport bike: a live colour dash with speed, gear, lean angle and a map, two live mirrors, a smoked bubble screen.

RIDE IT LIKE A REAL BIKE
